subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Eleventh graders read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poems, at the high end of the grades 11-CCR (college and career readiness) complexity band, independently and proficiently, applying all skills: multiple themes, complex characters, figurative language, structure, point of view (including irony), and strong evidence.

items.prompt:
Read.

The senator built his career on promises to the poor, then voted every time with the wealthy who funded him.

What does this reveal, and what tone does the author take?

steps: The author presents the gap critically, with irony.
So it reveals his hypocrisy, and the author's tone is critical/ironic.
solution.answer: It reveals his hypocrisy; the author's tone is critical and ironic.

items.prompt:
Read.

The river, patient and ancient, had outlasted every empire that tried to tame it.

Identify the device and its effect.

steps: The river is given human traits (patient) and outlasting power, that is personification.
It conveys nature's enduring power over human ambition.
So personification conveys nature's enduring power.
solution.answer: Personification conveying nature's enduring power over human ambition.
